title: Lydian electrum coins, among the earliest
summary: The kingdom of Lydia struck coins of electrum, a natural gold-silver alloy; they are among the oldest coins in existence.
why: Lydia is often credited with the world's first coinage.

notes.problem: Title claims more than summary and source: 'Lydian coins, made of electrum, are among the oldest in existence'.
Priority of coinage is not settled; source's own body says 'among the oldest in existence'.

superlativeSource: Lydian coins, made of electrum, are among the oldest in existence
